scope: General iodine function, dietary sources, population context and public safety guidance
reference_summary: The NHS page is an independent public-health reference for iodine. It highlights population and dietary context and warns that excessive iodine can affect thyroid function. It does not validate the composition, form, efficacy, suitability, dose or safety of any Strunz product or individual use case.
dose_handling: Any numeric guidance on the source remains source context only and is not imported as a patient, product or practice dose.
